description: Korean franchise contract deadlines for a franchisee (가맹사업법): 14-day cooling-off after the disclosure document (7 days with legal advice, 제7조), contract given 14 days before signing (제11조), refund demand within 4 months (제10조), sales forecast in writing for big franchisors (제9조), renewal request window 180-90 days before expiry and the 10-year renewal right (제13조), termination requiring 2 written notices with 2 months' cure (제14조). Deadline check only; no representation.

advised.description: Got advice from a lawyer or franchise consultant

bigHq.description: Franchisor is not an SME or has 100+ outlets

contractGiven.description: Date the contract text was received

currentEnd.description: End of the current contract term

firstStart.description: Start of the first contract (10-year renewal right)

infoGiven.description: Date the disclosure document (정보공개서) was received
